preparation: Initially sugar-depleted intact human erythrocytes, 30 s uptake on ice. Concentration is in mM. Rates and their SE are in µmol/L/min as in the caption. The caption does not specify the volume denominator.
mapping: The bars are standard errors from three independent experiments in triplicate. The first bar is unresolved. The plotted rates reflect early zero-trans net entry. The operator predicts a one-way instantaneous rate in a common empirical scale. The study also measured later equilibration and faster tracer exchange after sugar preloading.
